He carried it up the spiral stairs, set it beside the lamp, and broke the seal with his thumbnail. The note was written in a careful, childish hand: 'If you find this, please tell the sea I am not afraid of it anymore.' There was no name, no date, only a small drawing of a boat. That evening, as the beam swept across the dark water, he opened the window and said the words aloud, just in case.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。街灯在空荡的马路上投下昏黄的光圈，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过潮湿的路面，发出轻微的沙沙声。便利店的灯依旧亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处的高楼只剩零星几扇窗户还透着光，像是不肯入睡的眼睛。环卫工人推着车慢慢走过，扫帚划过地面，节奏均匀。风从巷口吹来，带着一丝凉意和早点铺刚升起的炊烟。这座城市在沉睡与苏醒之间短暂停留，等待第一缕晨光。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something is solved by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It's like opening a set of nesting dolls: you keep opening smaller dolls until you reach the tiniest one.\n- The tiniest doll is the 'stop point', and then you put everything back together to get the answer."}
